newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp begun as mkt perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp begun as mkt perform.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it has initiated coverage of Telebras system, as a market performer at a price of $182.90.
-- The brokerage said Telesp, which serves Sao Paulo state, is one of Brazil's most efficient local operators and the strongest telecommunications franchise in the country.
-- "We believe Telesp's current share price already reflects the company's potential," Caspian said in a report.

-- Telesp is fully valued and has strong earnings and cash flow outlooks based on rapid line and cellular growth, continued rate rebalancing and clearer rules to be introduced for the sector in the next six to nine months, it said.
-- Caspian said it set a 12-month price target for Telesp of $218 per 1,000 shares, a return of 31 percent in nominal terms or 19 percent in U.S. dollars.
-- Both Telesp preferred and voting common were flat at 187.50 reais and 186.50 reais respectively at 1701 local time/1401 EST on the Sao Paulo bourse.
